<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
HeavyRailRifle.name: Heavy Rail Rifle

HellfireShells.description: Fires a burst of Hellfire shells at a target within {[range]} hexes. The shells deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage and +{[extraHit]}x hits against Big Targets. Rapid Fire does not apply to this ability.
HellfireShells.name: Hellfire Shells

HellfyreMissileRack.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Heavy>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to a target enemy unit within range {[range]} and an additional <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Heavy>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to each enemy unit on the map that was dealt <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> this turn, which can include the initial target again.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
HellfyreMissileRack.name: Hellfyre Missile Rack

HeraldOfTheApocalypse.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy directly behind the target. Affected enemies receive <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from the next attack made by a unit against them. Also triggers <style=Battle_Fatigue>Battle Fatigue</style> for all enemy units within {[range]} hexes of the original target.
HeraldOfTheApocalypse.name: Herald of the Apocalypse

HeroicFusillade.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free surrounding hex within movement range {[range]} of Judh or is already on a hex surrounding Judh. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to the target and all other enemies surrounding it. Crits deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each free hex surrounding the targeted enemy. When Judh is resurrected and Heroic Fusillade has already been used, then it can be used again in this battle.
HeroicFusillade.name: Heroic Fusillade

HolyDuel.description: <style=Faction_BlackTemplars>Brother Jaeger</style> <style=Debuff_Taunted>Taunts</style> an adjacent enemy unit and immediately performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style> against it. <style=Faction_BlackTemplars>Brother Jaeger</style> deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from the target while it’s <style=Debuff_Taunted>Taunted</style> by him. <style=Faction_BlackTemplars>Brother Jaeger</style> is also <style=Debuff_Taunted>Taunted</style> by the target and the taunt does not expire with rounds passed.
HolyDuel.name: Holy Duel

HostOfPlagues.description: Whenever a non-<style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> enemy unit dies there is a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}% chance</style> a <style=Summon><style=Faction_DeathGuard>Poxwalker</style></style> is spawned on the hex where that unit died.
HostOfPlagues.name: Host Of Plagues

HungeringSwarm.description: Whenever this unit performs a melee attack, it deals <style=Stat_Hits>+{[extraHit]} hit</style> for each other friendly Hormagaunt or Ripper Swarm adjacent to the target.
HungeringSwarm.name: Hungering Swarm

HunterOfSouls.description: At the start of his turn, <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Z'Kar</style> performs a normal attack against a target in range. This attack deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each adjacent friendly <style=Psyker>Psyker</style>. Afterwards, Z'Kar leaves the battlefield and returns as <style=MoW>Machine of War</style>. If he is defeated while on the battlefield, he also returns as <style=MoW>Machine of War</style>.
HunterOfSouls.name: Hunter of Souls

HuntersBeyondDeath.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against <style=Psyker>Psykers</style>, and enemy <style=Psyker>Psykers</style> within 2 hexes deal <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style>.

Unless they are <style=Immune>Immune</style>, Enemy <style=Psyker>Psykers</style> within 2 hexes will not hit an additional unit with their <style=NormalAttack>normal ranged attacks</style>.
HuntersBeyondDeath.name: Hunters Beyond Death

HuntersInstincts.description: Gains <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> while on a hex with <style=Tile_Grass>Tall Grass</style>.
HuntersInstincts.name: Hunter's Instincts

HyperAggression.description: Beginning on its second turn, after the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Screamer-Killer</style> uses an active ability, it also performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style>.
HyperAggression.name: Hyper-Aggression

HyperCorrosiveAcid.description: Enemies that are damaged by a friendly <style=Faction_Tyranids>Spore Mine</style> take <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> from attacks by <style=Rarity_Mythic>Mythic</style> <style=Character>characters</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
HyperCorrosiveAcid.name: Hyper Corrosive Acid

Hypermorph.description: Gains extra <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> equal to <style=Stat>{[healthPct]}%</style> of current <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
Hypermorph.name: Hypermorph

HypersensoryAbilities.description: The first time each enemy turn that <style=Faction_Genestealers>Judh</style> is attacked, she cannot fall below <style=Stat>{[hpPct]}%</style> of her current <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>. After the attack, she moves to a free adjacent hex and places a <style=Decoy>decoy</style> on the hex she moved from. Then, if she is within {[range]} hexes of the unit that attacked her, she deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Projectile>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> to that unit.
HypersensoryAbilities.name: Hypersensory Abilities

IllusionsOfTzeentch.description: At the start of the battle, creates a copy of the enemy team to fight for him. Copies have the same stats and ability levels as the original units. As long as one of these copies is on the battlefield, reduce all incoming damage to <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Thaumachus</style> by <style=Stat_Damage>{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>. Each time a copied character is defeated for the first time, Thaumachus loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style>.
IllusionsOfTzeentch.name: Illusions of Tzeentch

ImpossibleForm.description: Each turn, the 9th attack and every 9th additional attack against <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Magnus</style> deal <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>.
ImpossibleForm.name: Impossible Form

IncendiaryShells.description: Fires the Astartes shotgun at an enemy within {[range]} hexes, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style>.
IncendiaryShells.name: Incendiary Shells

Incursion.description:
Summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_BlackLegion>Bloodletter</style></style> adjacent to an enemy target within range {[range]}. The Bloodletter immediately attacks the target. Keeps summoning Bloodletters up to a max of {[maxSummons]}, as long as the target has not been defeated, is in range and has a free hex adjacent to it. 

Bloodletter’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
Incursion.name: Daemonic Incursion

InescapableAccuracy.description: If Maugan Ra has not moved, then his ranged attacks ignore hit reductions, have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance, and deal an additional {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. Inescapable Accuracy applies to targets of Harvester of Souls as well as attacks triggered by Overwatch.
InescapableAccuracy.name: Inescapable Accuracy

InescapableDeath.description:
<style=Faction_Necrons>Imospekh</style>’s <style=Stat_Range>ranged</style> attacks each deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> per <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> when triggered by <style=Overwatch>Overwatch</style>.

When defeating a unit with an attack triggered by <style=Overwatch>Overwatch</style>, <style=Faction_Necrons>Imospekh</style> stays in <style=Overwatch>Overwatch</style>, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> compared to the previous attack.
InescapableDeath.name: Inescapable Death

InfernalCannon.description:
Targets a hex on the battlefield. Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies that are on <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style> hexes or have taken <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> this turn. Then adds <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style> to the targeted hex.

Initial <style=Cooldown>cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>. 

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
InfernalCannon.name: Infernal Cannon

InfernalPacts.description: Friendly <style=Aliance_Chaos>Chaos</style> units adjacent to <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Abraxas</style> deal an additional <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> with their <style=NormalAttack>normal ranged attacks</style>. Affected <style=Daemon>Daemons</style> also gain the bonus <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> on their <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attack</style>.
InfernalPacts.name: Infernal Pacts

InspiredToGreatness.description: Enables a friendly unit in an adjacent hex to use their active ability again in this battle and heals or repairs it for {[hpToHeal]} Health. For this second use, the ability is at the lowest of its own level and that of Inspired to Greatness. If that unit has not used their active ability yet, then {[hpToHeal_2]} Health is restored instead.
InspiredToGreatness.name: Inspired to Greatness

IntegratedCircuits.description: Any time a friendly unit is <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>, the <style=Faction_Necrons>Menhir</style> also takes that same amount of Damage as <style=DMG_Direct>Direct Damage</style>.
IntegratedCircuits.name: Integrated Circuits

IntoxicatingElixir.description: The relic bearer deals <style=Stat_CritDamage>+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for each unit within range {[range]} that is <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style>, <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style>, <style=Debuff_Taunted>Taunted</style>, or <style=ThrillSeekers>Thrilled</style>, up to a maximum of {[nrOfUnits]} times. This bonus is doubled if the relic bearer is at or below <style=Stat_Health>{[healthPct]}% Health</style>.
IntoxicatingElixir.name: Intoxicating Elixir

InvocationOfMachineVengeance.description:
Summons <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Tech-Priest Enginseers</style></style> at the bottom of the map. Then adds <style=Stat>{[effectLevel]}</style> level of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style> to all friendly <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> units on the battlefield.

Tech-Priest Enginseer stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
InvocationOfMachineVengeance.name: Invocation of Machine Vengeance

ItItches.description:
<style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppresses</style> and <style=Displacement>pushes</style> an adjacent enemy unit and all enemy units adjacent to both the target and the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Parasite of Mortrex</style> one hex backwards. Enemy <style=Steppable>steppables</style> on affected hexes are destroyed. Then summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_Tyranids>Ripper Swarm</style></style> in each hex vacated by this ability. The <style=Summon><style=Faction_Tyranids>Ripper Swarms</style></style> can immediately attack. The <style=Faction_Tyranids>Parasite of Mortrex</style> may move again after activating this ability.

Ripper Swarm stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
ItItches.name: It Itches!

ItsGonnaBlow.description:
If this unit is <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style> the ammo box explodes, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all adjacent hexes.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
ItsGonnaBlow.name: It’s Gonna Blow

JakhalStimms.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy and all other enemies adjacent to both Macer and the target. Then Macer loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health. Using Jakhal Stimms does not end Macer's turn.
JakhalStimms.name: Jakhal Stimms

KardiocoreGalvanus.description: The relic bearer deals <style=Stat_CritDamage>+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for each friendly adjacent <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> unit.
KardiocoreGalvanus.name: Kardiocore Galvanus

KillMaimBurn.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy. Then performs a second attack targeting an adjacent enemy, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Eviscerate>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Eviscerating Damage</style>. Then performs a third attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_3]}x</style> <style=DMG_Plasma>{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Plasma Damage</style>. All attacks prioritize the same target until it is killed and then prioritise kills.
KillMaimBurn.name: Kill! Maim! Burn!

KissOfDeath.description: The <style=Faction_Aeldari>Harlequin Player</style> disappears and deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Direct>{[dmg]} Direct Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy, and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to a previous target, then it reappears in a hex adjacent to the last target hit.
KissOfDeath.name: Kiss of Death

KustomForceField.description: All friendly adjacent units have an additional <style=Stat_Armor>+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style>.
KustomForceField.name: Kustom Force Field

LashOfTorment.description: Deals<style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Eviscerate>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage</style> to an enemy unit within range {[range]}. If the target is not already adjacent to <style=Faction_EmperorsChildren>Lucius</style>, it is then <style=Displacement>pulled</style> 1 hex towards him if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. If the target is adjacent to Lucius after the attack, it is also <style=Debuff_Taunted>Taunted</style> by him for <style=Stat>{[nrOfRounds]}</style> rounds.
LashOfTorment.name: Lash of Torment

LeadingTheCharge.description:
If <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Dreir</style> has not moved, he gains <style=Buff_Infiltrate>Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn and <style=Charging>charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to it. Then, summons up to <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Death Riders</style></style> in free adjacent hexes that can immediately attack enemies in range. All attacks triggered by this ability have <style=Piercing_Ratio>+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle. 

Death Rider stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
LeadingTheCharge.name: Leading the Charge

LegacyOfCombat.description: After performing his first attack each turn, <style=Faction_Custodes>Kariyan</style> performs an additional attack. If he is adjacent to an enemy <style=Big_Target>Big Target</style>, this attack deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Piercing Damage</style> to it. If there is no adjacent enemy <style=Big_Target>Big Target</style>, <style=Faction_Custodes>Kariyan</style> deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to each adjacent enemy instead.
LegacyOfCombat.name: Legacy Of Combat

LegendaryCommander.description: Enemies receive <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> if they are adjacent to any friendly unit that has used an active ability this turn. If the affected enemies are also adjacent to <style=Faction_Custodes>Trajann</style>, friendly <style=Character>Characters</style> score <style=Stat>{[nrOfHits]}</style> additional <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> against them with their first attack that is not a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style>.
LegendaryCommander.name: Legendary Commander

LethalMiasma.description: At the start of the Tervigon’s turn, any adjacent enemy units suffer <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Direct>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>.
LethalMiasma.name: Lethal Miasma

Lifewards.description: If <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Celestine</style> is in an adjacent hex and takes Damage, that post-Armour Damage is taken as <style=DMG_Direct>Direct Damage</style> by the <style=Summon>Geminae Superia</style> instead.
Lifewards.name: Lifewards

LightImUp.description: After performing a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style>, <style=Faction_Orks>Boss Gulgortz</style> performs a second attack against the same enemy, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Projectile>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style>. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to any random enemy target within {[range]} hexes.
LightImUp.name: Light ’im up!

LightOfSanguinius.description: If <style=Faction_BloodAngels>Dante</style> has not moved, he gains <style=Buff_Infiltrate>Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn, then <style=Charging>charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} and deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Melta>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style> to it. The target and enemy units surrounding it deal <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This effect is doubled if they attack friendly units that are at or below <style=Stat_Health>{[healthPct]}% Health</style>.
LightOfSanguinius.name: Light of Sanguinius

LionHelm.description: Friendly units within {[range]} hexes block an additional <style=Stat_Damage>{[blockDmg]} Damage</style> when they <style=Stat_Block>Block</style> and deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with attacks triggered by <style=Overwatch>Overwatch</style>. Other friendly <style=Faction_DarkAngels>Dark Angels</style> within {[range]} hexes also have their <style=Stat_Block>Block</style> <style=Stat_Chance>chance</style> increased by <style=Stat>+{[blockChance]}%</style>
LionHelm.name: Lion Helm

ListenUpMaggots.description: When <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Kell</style></style> is in play, Lord Castellan Creed’s active ability summons 1 extra <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsman</style></style> and has {[range]} hexes range instead of 2.
ListenUpMaggots.name: Listen Up, Maggots!

LivingBatteringRam.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Physical>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to an adjacent target with a <style=Stat>{[stunChance]}% chance</style> to <style=Debuff_Stunned>stun</style> it for 1 round. The target is also <style=Displacement>thrown</style> 2 hexes away from the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Screamer-Killer</style>. If the hex the target lands in was occupied, the occupying unit will be <style=Displacement>pushed</style> 1 hex in a random direction. The target is then dealt an additional <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Direct>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage</style>, regardless if it was thrown or not.
LivingBatteringRam.name: Living Battering Ram

LivingLightning.description:
After moving, deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Direct>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to one random adjacent enemy.
If <style=Faction_Necrons>Thutmose</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
LivingLightning.name: Living Lightning

Loki_SwoopingHawk.description:
Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[dmg[0]]} Piercing Damage</style> to first target, <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[dmg[1]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the second, and <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[dmg[2]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
Loki_SwoopingHawk.name: Swooping Hawk
