PlagueburstMortar.name: Plagueburst Mortar

PlagueWind.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style><style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage</style>. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
PlagueWind.name: Plague Wind

PlasmaCannon.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Plasma>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]} and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style=Cooldown>cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} round.</style> 

<style=Cooldown>Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.
PlasmaCannon.name: Plasma Cannon

PlasmaGrenade.description:
Throws a grenade at a target within {[range]} hexes, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Plasma>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to it and <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Plasma>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to enemy units in adjacent hexes. This ability benefits from <style=Indirect_Fire>Indirect Fire</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
PlasmaGrenade.name: Plasma Grenade

Possession.description:
Each time <style=Faction_BlackLegion>Archimatos</style> kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_BlackLegion>Bloodletter</style></style> in its hex. Each time he kills an enemy unit with a ranged attack, he summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_ThousandSons>Blue Horror</style></style> in its hex.

Bloodletter’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

Blue Horror's stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp_2]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg_2]} Damage</style>
Possession.name: Possession

PoundThemToDust.description: Performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style> and then marks an area of up to 7 hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, the <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style> deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Heavy>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to all units in the marked area.
PoundThemToDust.name: Pound them to Dust!

PowerTrip.description: <style=NormalAttack>Normal attacks</style> ignore <style=Stat_Armor>{[armorIgnored]} Armour</style>. If <style=Faction_Orks>Snappawrecka</style> is at full <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>, his <style=NormalAttack>normal attacks</style> additionally score <style=Stat_Hits>+{[extraHit]} hit</style> and reduce the target's Armour by <style=Stat_Armor>{[armorReduction]} Armour</style>, but also cause <style=Faction_Orks>Snappawrecka</style> to lose <style=Stat>{[hpPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
PowerTrip.name: Power Trip

PowerUp_Armor.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their <style=Stat_Armor>Armour</style> by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
PowerUp_Armor.name: Armour power-up

PowerUp_Bomb.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, triggers an explosion that deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemies within {[range]} hexes of the pick-up hex. The damage is increased at higher rarity tiers.
PowerUp_Bomb.name: Bomb power-up

PowerUp_Damage.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> by {[dmgPct]}%.
PowerUp_Damage.name: Damage power-up

PowerUp_Healing.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up <style=Healing>heals</style> that unit for {[HealPercentage]}% of their max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
PowerUp_Healing.name: Healing power-up

PowerUp_Health.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
PowerUp_Health.name: Health power-up

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys <style=Faction_Custodes>Kariyan</style> onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly <style=Character>characters</style>. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is <style=Obliterated>always overkilled</style>.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.name: From Golden Light

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys <style=Faction_Custodes>Aesoth</style> onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly <style=Character>characters</style>. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is <style=Obliterated>always overkilled</style>.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.name: From Golden Light

PowerUp_Hits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> on their attacks by +{[extraHit]}.
PowerUp_Hits.name: Hits power-up

PowerUp_MeleeHits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> on their <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style> attack by +{[extraHit]}.
PowerUp_MeleeHits.name: Melee hits power-up

PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up allows them to use their active ability again during the ongoing battle.
PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.name: Reactivate ability power-up

PowerUp_Reinforcement.description: Adds 1 Reinforcement point when picked up by a friendly unit.
PowerUp_Reinforcement.name: Reinforcement Point power-up

PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.description: When picked up by a unit, each deployed character in this event will deploy with a <style=Buff_Shield>Shield</style> equal to {[shieldPct]}% of their max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>. The shield strength accumulates with each additional Shield power-up you pick up.
PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.name: Shield power-up

PowerUp_Resurrect.description:
When picked up by a friendly unit, resurrects a chosen <style=Character>character</style> that has been defeated. The resurrected character spawns in a random free hex and can immediately take a turn. 

If there is no eligible character,  it adds 1 Reinforcement point instead.
PowerUp_Resurrect.name: Resurrection power-up

Poxwalkers.description:
Summons <style=Summon><style=Faction_DeathGuard>Poxwalkers</style></style> in <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}-{[chance_2]}%</style> of free hexes (rounded up) within <style=Faction_DeathGuard>Corrodius'</style> <style=ContagionsOfNurgle>Contagion</style> aura. Newly summoned <style=Summon><style=Faction_DeathGuard>Poxwalkers</style></style> immediately attack in <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.

Poxwalker’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
Poxwalkers.name: Poxwalkers

PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.description: If <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Belisarius Cawl</style> has at least <style=Stat>{[effectLevel]}</style> levels of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style> at the start of his turn, he deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Toxic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to all enemies on the battlefield.
PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.name: Pre-Calibrated Purge Solution

PrecisionShot.description: The Deathmark neither moves nor attacks for a turn, but instead takes aim. On its next turn, it is not allowed to move, but is able to fire its Synaptic Disintegrator with incredible accuracy, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Energy>{[dmg]} Energy Damage</style>.
PrecisionShot.name: Precision Shot

PrehensilePincerTail.description: When the Hive Tyrant attacks an enemy in melee, that target or an enemy unit adjacent to both the target and the Hive Tyrant takes <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Physical>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style>.
PrehensilePincerTail.name: Prehensile Pincer Tail

PriorityReclamation.description: While there is an <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Archeotec Crate</style> on the battlefield, <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Actus</style> receives <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>, but loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> each time an enemy destroys an Archeotec Crate. At the end of his turn, if Actus is adjacent to an Archeotec Crate, he removes one Archeotec Crate and all friendly <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> units gain <style=Stat>{[effectLevel]}</style> levels of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style>.
PriorityReclamation.name: Priority Reclamation

ProperKilly.description: Always eager to engage the toughest foe, <style=Faction_Orks>Ghazghkull</style>'s melee attack prioritises the unit with the highest current health total. He slashes with Gork's Klaw, attacking all enemies in the 3 hexes in front of him. Each target takes <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]} hit</style> that deals {[dmgPct]}% of their <style=Stat_Health>Max Health</style> as <style=DMG_Power>Power Damage</style>. When damage is dealt this way, each target hit is also <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style> for 1 round. Afterwards each target is hit with <style=Faction_Orks>Ghazghkull</style>'s <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attack</style>.
ProperKilly.name: Proper Killy

ProphetOfGorkAndMork.description: After being attacked <style=Stat>{[nrOfAttacks]}</style> times in a turn, <style=Faction_Orks>Ghazghkull</style> takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style> until the end of that turn.
ProphetOfGorkAndMork.name: Prophet of Gork and Mork

PsychicDominion.description: <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Magnus</style> takes  <style=DMG_Psychic>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage</style> and <style=Psyker>Psykers</style> receive <style=Stat_Damage>+{[dmgPct]}% Damage</style> from his attacks.
PsychicDominion.name: Psychic Dominion

PsychicFortress.description: All friendly surrounding units have an added <style=Stat_Block>Block</style> with <style=Stat_Chance>{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to block <style=Stat_Damage>{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>. Also reduces incoming <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> by {[dmgReduction]}.
PsychicFortress.name: Psychic Fortress

PsychicMaelstrom.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}% chance</style> to score another <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>.

If it does, <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance_2]}% chance</style> to score another <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>. 
If it does, <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance_3]}% chance</style> to score another <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>. 
If it does, <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance_4]}% chance</style> to score another <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
PsychicMaelstrom.name: Psychic Maelstrom

PsychicStalk.description:
Attacks that deal <style=DMG_Flame>Flame Damage</style> and <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> to enemies that are on hexes with <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style> deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>. Affected attacks from friendly <style=Aliance_Chaos>Chaos</style> units deal an additional <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

The hex of each enemy that is hit by <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Ahriman</style>'s <style=NormalAttack>normal ranged attack</style> catches <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style>.
PsychicStalk.name: Psychic Stalk

Pyreblaster.description: When performing a ranged attack, sets the hex behind the enemy on <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style> and deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to any enemy on that hex.
Pyreblaster.name: Pyreblaster

RadBombardment.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Toxic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to all units in a straight line in one of 6 directions and adds <style=Tile_Contamination>Contamination</style> to all hexes in the line. All units hit are <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style> for 1 round. The length of the line starts at 2 hexes and increases by 1 hex for each round that has passed and by 1 hex each time a friendly <style=Mechanic>Mechanic</style> restores <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> of a unit.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
RadBombardment.name: Rad-Bombardment

RadSaturation.description: After the <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Skitarii Vanguard</style> moves, it adds <style=Tile_Contamination>Contamination</style> to its hex. If it does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of its turn.
RadSaturation.name: Rad-Saturation

RadZoneCorps.description:
At the beginning of <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Tan Gi'Da's</style> turn, he deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Toxic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to each enemy that has their <style=Stat_Armor>Armour</style> reduced. At the end of his turn, he summons <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Skitarii Vanguard</style></style> at the top of the map and <style=Tile_Contamination>Contaminates</style> one row of hexes on the battlefield.

Skitarii Vanguard stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
RadZoneCorps.name: Rad-Zone Corps

Ramshackle.description: Takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReduction]} damage</style> from attacks with damage types that have <style=Piercing_Ratio>{[pierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> or lower.
Ramshackle.name: Ramshackle

RapidFire.description: The <style=Faction_Ultramarines>Heavy Intercessor</style> attacks twice if he did not move this turn, with each of the two attacks dealing <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> as normal.
RapidFire.name: Rapid Fire

RealityUnbound.description: For each different enemy unit that was dealt <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> this turn <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Yazaghor</style> deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraMaxDmg]} Maximum Damage</style> with his <style=NormalAttack>normal ranged attacks</style>. If three or more different enemy units have been dealt <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> this turn he gains <style=Stat_Movement>+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> and his normal ranged attack gets <style=Stat_Range>+{[extraRange]} Range</style> until the end of this turn.
RealityUnbound.name: Reality Unbound

ReanimationProtocols.description: If there is at least one other friendly unit of the same type on the battlefield when this unit is defeated, it has a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}% chance</style> to be immediately revived with <style=Stat>{[hpPct]}%</style> of its initial Health in the same hex or a random adjacent one. Does not apply if <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>.
ReanimationProtocols.name: Reanimation Protocols

ReapingScythe.description: Attacks a unit in melee by swinging Silence in a wide arc, hitting the target and all enemy units adjacent to the target for <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Chain>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage</style>. Mortarion prefers to target <style=Psyker>Psykers</style> with this ability.
ReapingScythe.name: Reaping Scythe

RedThirst.description: If this unit is at or below <style=Stat_Health>{[healthPct]}% Health</style>, it gains <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and scores <style=Stat_Hits>+{[extraHit]} hit</style> when <style=Charging>charging</style>.
RedThirst.name: Red Thirst

RefusalToBeOutdone.description: Friendly characters attacking enemies adjacent to Laviscus increase his Outrage equal to the highest damage dealt by any of their non-psychic hits this turn. Laviscus' Damage stat is increased by {[extraDmgPct]}% of his Outrage and his normal attacks deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each friendly Chaos character that increased his Outrage this turn. After Laviscus performs a normal attack, his Outrage resets.
RefusalToBeOutdone.name: Refusal to be Outdone

ReinforcedHiveNode.description: Every second round – starting from the first the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Tyranid Warrior</style> is in play – the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Tyranid Warrior</style> has <style=Stat_Armor>+100% Armour</style> and – if it has <style=Stat_Block>Block</style> – 100% <style=Stat_Block>Block <style=Stat_Chance>chance</style></style>.
ReinforcedHiveNode.name: Reinforced Hive Node

Reinforcements.description: At the start of <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Sibyll Devine’s</style> turn, <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsmen</style></style> are summoned at the top of the map and immediately take a turn. Each time a friendly <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsman</style></style> is defeated, <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Sibyll Devine</style> is dealt <style=DMG_Psychic>{[dmg]} Psychic Damage</style>.
Reinforcements.name: Reinforcements!

RelentlessMarch.description: Gives +1 <style=Stat_Movement>Movement</style> to all friendly units that start their turn in an adjacent hex. Also <style=Repairing>repairs</style> affected <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> units for <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToRepair]} Health</style>.
RelentlessMarch.name: Relentless March

RelicBoltPistol.description: The relic bearer gains <style=Piercing_Ratio>+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> with melee attacks and deals <style=Stat_CritDamage>+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> with ranged attacks. These bonuses are doubled against <style=Aliance_Chaos>Chaos</style> or <style=Aliance_Xenos>Xenos</style> enemies.
RelicBoltPistol.name: Relic Bolt Pistol

RelicOfLostCadia.description: Friendly surrounding <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> <style=Summon>Summons</style> have <style=FinalJustice>Final Vengeance</style>. When the relic bearer is defeated, summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsman</style></style> in its hex with <style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>, <style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style> and <style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>.
RelicOfLostCadia.name: Relic of Lost Cadia

RelicPowerFist.description: The relic bearer's attacks that deal <style=DMG_Power>Power Damage</style> have a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}% chance</style> to <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppress</style> and a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance_2]}% chance</style> to <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stun</style> enemies targeted by them. These chances are doubled if the attack is an active ability.
RelicPowerFist.name: Relic Power Fist

Repair.description:
<style=Mechanic>Mechanics</style> can <style=Repairing>repair</style> friendly <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> units as their action.
The amount of <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> restored equals the <style=Mechanic>Mechanic</style>'s Damage multiplied by the highest number of <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> of any of their weapons.
Repair.name: Repair

ResurrectionOrb.description:
In a free adjacent hex, summons 1 <style=Summon><style=Faction_Necrons>Necron Warrior</style></style> for each round that has started. Summons 1 more <style=Summon><style=Faction_Necrons>Necron Warrior</style></style> for each friendly unit with the trait <style=Living_Metal>Living Metal</style> that was defeated in this battle.

Necron Warrior’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
ResurrectionOrb.name: Resurrection Orb

Reveal.description: An enemy within {[range]} hexes that is not <style=Debuff_Revealed>Revealed</style> and has defeated a friendly <style=Faction_Aeldari>Aeldari</style> unit this battle becomes <style=Debuff_Revealed>Revealed</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. Friendly <style=Faction_Aeldari>Aeldari</style> that attack <style=Debuff_Revealed>Revealed</style> enemies ignore any hit reductions and deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>.
Reveal.name: Reveal

RevitalizingMalignancy.description: <style=Healing>Heals</style> himself and all adjacent friendly units for <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>, and an additional <style=Stat_Health>+{[hpToHeal_2]} Health</style> to <style=Aliance_Chaos>Chaos</style> units. <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> units do not receive any <style=Healing>healing</style>.
RevitalizingMalignancy.name: Revitalising Malignancy

RevoltinglyResilient.description: When attacked, each hit after the first {[nrOfHits]} hits in that same attack deals {[dmgPctReduction]}% less Damage than the previous hit. The first {[nrOfHits]} hits of each attack deal normal damage, the next hit 50% damage, the next hit 25%, etc.
RevoltinglyResilient.name: Revoltingly Resilient

RighteousRepugnance.description: <style=NormalAttack>Normal melee attacks</style> deal an additional <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to the target and to all enemy units adjacent to both the target and to <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Morvenn Vahl</style>. When <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Morvenn Vahl</style> defeats a unit with a melee attack, it has a <style=Stat>{[chance]}%</style> chance to count twice for <style=Act_Of_Faith>Act of Faith</style>.
RighteousRepugnance.name: Righteous Repugnance

RitesOfBattle.description: Adjacent friendly units gain <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> units gain <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> instead.
RitesOfBattle.name: Rites of Battle

RitesOfMorkai.description: Baldr and all surrounding friendly non-mechanical units become Inspired for 1 round or until they are revived. The first time each inspired unit would be defeated, it is instead revived with {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Inspired units with Final Vengeance deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with all attacks. After using this ability, Baldr immediately performs a normal melee attack against an adjacent enemy.
RitesOfMorkai.name: Rites of Battle

RitesOfRestoration.description: <style=Healing>Heals</style> herself and all adjacent friendly units for <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>. Resurrects {[nrOfHeroes]} random friendly <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> <style=Character>Character</style> and up to <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> random friendly <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> <style=Summon>Summons</style> that have been defeated in this battle. Resurrected units appear in free adjacent hexes with <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> and are unable to act on this turn. Only affects non-<style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> units.
RitesOfRestoration.name: Rites of Restoration

SagaOfTheWarriorBorn.description:
When <style=Charging>charging</style>, <style=Faction_SpaceWolves>Ragnar</style> scores <style=Stat>{[extraHits]}</style> additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> and his critical hits deal an additional <style=Stat_CritDamage>+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style>.

If Ragnar has defeated one or more enemy <style=Character>Characters</style> this battle, friendly <style=Faction_SpaceWolves>Space Wolves</style> also gain this ability.
SagaOfTheWarriorBorn.name: Saga of the Warrior Born

SanctorumMissile.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to a target within range {[range]} and <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all hexes adjacent to the target – with the exception of Morvenn Vahl's own hex, were she adjacent to the target.
SanctorumMissile.name: Sanctorum Missile

SanguinaryPriest.description: After moving, all adjacent friendly non-mechanical units <style=Regenerate>regenerate</style> <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToHeal]}-{[maxHpToHeal]} Health</style>. If <style=Faction_BloodAngels>Nicodemus</style> does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
SanguinaryPriest.name: Sanguinary Priest

SavageKiller.description: When a <style=Summon>Summon</style> moves to or is summoned adjacent to <style=Faction_SpaceWolves>Ulf</style>, he immediately deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to it. <style=Faction_SpaceWolves>Ulf</style> will also perform this ability against any enemy that attempts to use an active ability while in a hex adjacent to him, in which case he deals his <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> before that unit's ability is activated.
SavageKiller.name: Savage Killer

SaviorProtocols.description:
If a friendly adjacent <style=Faction_Tau>T'au Empire</style> unit is attacked, there is a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}%</style> chance for each hit to be scored against this Drone instead of the original target.

When moving, this Drone prioritises hexes adjacent to friendly <style=Faction_Tau>T'au Empire</style> units. 

When attacking, this Drone tries to prioritise enemies with a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style>.
SaviorProtocols.name: Saviour Protocols

ScarabHive.description:
Summons 2 <style=Summon><style=Faction_Necrons>Scarab Swarms</style></style> next to the target, whom they immediately attack using the Damage type <style=DMG_Piercing>Piercing</style>. In any subsequent attack they use their normal damage type.

Scarab Swarm’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
ScarabHive.name: Scarab Hive

ScarabSummon.description: Summons another <style=Faction_Necrons>Scarab Swarm</style> in a free adjacent hex, which then immediately takes a turn.
ScarabSummon.name: Scarab Summon

ScreamerInvocation.description:
The first time there are no allied <style=Daemon>Daemons</style> on the battlefield at the end of his turn, <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Abraxas</style> summons <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_ThousandSons>Screamers</style></style> onto random hexes on the battlefield. When a friendly Daemon is defeated, Abraxas loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style>. As long as there are friendly Daemons on the battlefield, all incoming damage to Abraxas is reduced by <style=Stat_Damage>{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>.

Screamer of Tzeentch stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
ScreamerInvocation.name: Screamer Invocation

ScytheOfDust.description: <style=Faction_Necrons>Mesophet</style> does a mighty sweep with his scythe, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Energy>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage</style> to all enemies in adjacent hexes.
ScytheOfDust.name: Scythe of Dust

ScythingTalons.description:
Attacks an enemy in melee for <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Bio>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage</style> and any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Tyranid Warrior</style> take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Bio>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage</style>. 

Double hits against <style=Summon>Summons</style>.
ScythingTalons.name: Scything Talons

SeekerMissileFrequencyLock.description:
A target enemy unit within {[range]} receives a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style> until the end of <style=Faction_Tau>Sho'syl</style>'s next turn.
At the beginning of <style=Faction_Tau>Sho'syl</style>'s next turn, if he is still in play, the target is hit by a Seeker Missile dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Heavy>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
SeekerMissileFrequencyLock.name: Seeker Missile Frequency Lock

SelfRepairMechanism.description: Beginning with the end of round <style=Stat>{[nrOfRounds]}</style>, at the end of each of his turns, <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Belisarius Cawl</style> <style=Repairing>repairs</style> himself for <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToRepair]} Health</style> for each level of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style> he has.
SelfRepairMechanism.name: Self-Repair Mechanism

SelfRepairMechanismReworked.description: Beginning with the end of round <style=Stat>{[nrOfRounds]}</style>, at the end of each of his turns, <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Belisarius Cawl</style> gains <style=Stat_Armor>+ {[extraArmor]} Armour</style> for each level of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style> he has.
SelfRepairMechanismReworked.name: Self-Repair Mechanism

SendInTheNextWave.description:
Select a target within 2 hexes. Summon <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsmen</style></style> plus one for each defeated friendly unit, who immediately appear and fire upon a target from random free hexes within range 2 of the target. The maximum number of <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsmen</style></style> this can summon is <style=Stat>{[maxSummons]}</style>. 

Cadian Guardsman’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SendInTheNextWave.name: Send In The Next Wave

SentinelDirectives.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]} and Suppresses it for 1 round. Cannot be used if there is an enemy adjacent to Sy-Gex. Using Sentinel Directives does not end Sy-Gex's turn and he can still enter Overwatch this turn, unless he performs a normal attack.
SentinelDirectives.name: Sentinel Directives

SereneUnifier.description:
<style=Faction_Tau>Aun'Shi</style> grants himself, and adjacent friendly units a bonus based on the current round at the beginning of his turn. Friendly <style=Faction_Tau>T'au Empire</style> units within {[range]} hexes also receive this bonus. The bonus lasts until the start of the unit's next turn, even if <style=Faction_Tau>Aun'Shi</style> is defeated. The following Buffs are granted subsequently in each round:

1: <style=BUFF_no_underscore>Sense of Stone</style>: units take <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>
2: <style=BUFF_no_underscore>Zephyr's Grace</style>: units receive <style=Stat_Movement>+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style>
3: <style=BUFF_no_underscore>Storm of Fire</style>: units gain <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>

After round 3, the cycle begins again and will continue to repeat until <style=Faction_Tau>Aun'Shi</style> is defeated.
SereneUnifier.name: Serene Unifier

ShieldOfFaith.description: When a friendly <style=Rarity_Mythic>Mythic</style> <style=Character>character</style> <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crits</style> or attacks an enemy that is on a hex with <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style>, it gains a <style=Buff_Shield>Shield</style> until the start of its next turn, unless it already has a shield. The shield's <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> is <style=Stat>{[shieldPct]}%</style> of the affected character's maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
ShieldOfFaith.name: Shield of Faith

ShockAssault.description: Whenever <style=Faction_Ultramarines>Bellator</style> attacks, any <style=Summon><style=Faction_Ultramarines>Inceptor</style></style> adjacent to him also attacks eligible targets, dealing <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for this attack.
ShockAssault.name: Shock Assault

Shrapnel.description: The <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Mortar Team's</style> ranged attack deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to {[nrOfProjectiles]} random hexes adjacent to their target. Units hit are also <style=Suppressive_Fire>Suppressed</style>.
Shrapnel.name: Shrapnel

ShroudPsalm.description: Up to {[nrOfTargets]} other friendly units gain {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance and are affected by Shroud Psalm until the start of their next turn. Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and normal attacks against them score -{[hitsReduction]} hits, to a minimum of 1.
ShroudPsalm.name: Shroud Psalm

SilentDeath.description: Jain Zar throws the Silent Death at an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to it and up to {[nrOfTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to each other, before returning to Jain Zar’s hands.
SilentDeath.name: Silent Death

Skullsmasher.description: <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Macer</style> deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each <style=Stat>{[hpPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> he is currently missing. In addition, if <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Macer</style> has defeated an enemy this battle, all enemies he attacks become <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style>.
Skullsmasher.name: Skullsmasher

SkyStrike.description:
If <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Celestine</style> has not moved, she targets an enemy unit on the battlefield that has a free adjacent hex, then moves adjacent to it and attacks it. The attack deals the same damage as her <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style> plus an additional  <style=DMG_Power>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

<style=Cooldown>Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.
SkyStrike.name: Sky Strike

SlashingDive.description: Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[dmg[0]]} Power Damage</style> to first target, <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[dmg[1]]} Power Damage</style> to the second, and <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[dmg[2]]} Power Damage</style> to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.
SlashingDive.name: Slashing Dive

SmashaEad.description: When he traverses 2 or more hexes during his turn, then <style=Faction_Orks>Tanksmasha</style> gains <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for <style=NormalAttack>normal attacks</style> and takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> until the start of his next turn.
SmashaEad.name: Smasha 'Ead

SolarAtomizer.description: Transfers all levels of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style> from other friendly <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> units to <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Belisarius Cawl</style>. Additionally <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Belisarius Cawl</style> faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide. At the beginning of his next turn, deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Melta>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.
SolarAtomizer.name: Solar Atomizer

SorcerousFacade.description: Target a friendly Psyker. Until the beginning of Yazaghor's next turn both he and the target deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage with their normal attacks. Yazaghor performs a normal attack against the closest enemy unit, and then switches positions with the targeted Psyker. Note: this ability can only be used if Yazaghor has an enemy in range.
SorcerousFacade.name: Sorcerous Facade

SoulHunger.description:
Enemy Psykers take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> when using Active abilities or Smite within {[range]} hexes from the Hive Tyrant.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
SoulHunger.name: Soul Hunger

SpawnTermagants.description:
Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} <style=Summon>Termagants</style>, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there.

Termagant’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SpawnTermagants.name: Spawn Termagants

SpawnTermagants2.description:
Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} <style=Summon>Termagants</style>, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there.

Termagant’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SpawnTermagants2.name: Spawn Termagants

SpawnTermagants3.description:
Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} <style=Summon>Termagants</style>, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there.

Termagant’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SpawnTermagants3.name: Spawn Termagants

SpiritLeech.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. If the target is <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style>, deals an additional <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>, otherwise <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppresses</style> it. The <style=Faction_Tyranids>Neurothrope</style> <style=Healing>heals</style> itself and friendly <style=Faction_Tyranids>Tyranids</style> adjacent to it for <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> equal to <style=Stat>{[hpToHealPct]}%</style> of the total damage dealt with this ability.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
SpiritLeech.name: Spirit Leech

SpiritualLeader.description:
After moving, places a <style=Decoy>decoy</style> on an empty adjacent hex. Then, if there are 2 or more decoys adjacent to <Style=Faction_Genestealers>Xybia</style>, summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_Genestealers>Neophyte Hybrid</style></style> on one adjacent decoy. If <Style=Faction_Genestealers>Xybia</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of her turn.

Neophyte Hybrid stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SpiritualLeader.name: Spiritual Leader

Split.description:
When this unit gets defeated, it summons 2 <style=Summon><style=Faction_ThousandSons>Blue Horrors</style></style> in adjacent hexes. Does not apply if <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>. Newly summoned <style=Summon><style=Faction_ThousandSons>Blue Horrors</style></style> can immediately attack an enemy if summoned during the <style=Summon><style=Faction_ThousandSons>Pink Horror</style></style>'s turn, but cannot move until their next turn.

Blue Horror's stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
Split.name: Split

SporeMineLauncher.description: Summons a Spore Mine onto a free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage damage with Floating Death.
SporeMineLauncher.name: Spore Mine Launcher

Spotter.description: Friendly units within {[range]} hexes with the trait <style=Heavy_Weapon>Heavy Weapon</style> gain <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.
Spotter.name: Spotter

SpotterReworked.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks. Affected units with <style=Heavy_Weapon>Heavy Weapon</style> deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks instead.
SpotterReworked.name: Spotter

SquigHound.description:
Friendly <style=Summon><style=Faction_Orks>Grots</style></style> ignore <style=Battle_Fatigue>Battle Fatigue</style>. <style=Faction_Orks>Snotflogga</style>'s <style=NormalAttack>normal attacks</style> deal an additional <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Physical>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style>. After attacking, if there are less than <style=Stat>{[maxSummons]}</style> friendly <style=Summon><style=Faction_Orks>Grots</style></style> on the battlefield, they summon a <style=Summon><style=Faction_Orks>Grot</style></style> adjacent to the target that immediately can attack.

Grot’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
SquigHound.name: Squig Hound

SquigLaunchas.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Physical>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to an enemy unit that has at least {[nrOfUnits]} friendly <style=Faction_Orks>Ork</style> or {[nrOfUnits_2]} friendly units adjacent to it. Then, if the target has {[nrOfUnits_3]} friendly Orks or {[nrOfUnits_4]} friendly units adjacent to it, summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_Orks>Large Squig</style></style> on a random free hex adjacent to the target. 

Large Squig stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

Initial <style=Cooldown>cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>. 
Cost: <style=Resource_MachinesOfWarAmmo>{[munitionsCost]} munition</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
SquigLaunchas.name: Squig Launchas

SquigMine.description:
Marks a free hex on the battlefield and additionally <style=Stat>{[nrOfTiles]}</style> random free hexes within range {[range]} of the target hex. Until the start of the <style=Faction_Orks>Rukkatrukk</style>'s next turn, the first time a marked hex is occupied by an enemy, that enemy takes <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style>, and the mark is removed. When a friendly unit occupies an affected hex, it does not take damage, and the mark is removed.

Initial <style=Cooldown>cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>. 

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
SquigMine.name: Squig Mine

StaffOfStars.description: Hapthatra unleashes the full power of the Staff of Stars, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to an initial target and {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy Damage to all enemies adjacent to that target. Summons take double Damage.
StaffOfStars.name: Staff of Stars

StandVigil.description: Friendly surrounding units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with attacks that are not normal attacks. If a friendly Adeptus Custodes uses an Active Ability, Stand Vigil affects all other friendly units within {[range]} hexes for 1 round.
StandVigil.name: Stand Vigil

Stikkbomb.description: Throws a grenade at a target, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to the target and <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to units in hexes adjacent to the target. Range {[range]} and <style=Indirect_Fire>Indirect Fire</style> applies.
Stikkbomb.name: Stikkbomb

StormboyzStrike.description: In its first turn this unit flies into any free hex, instead of starting on its designated spawn point. There's a {[chance]}% chance it misses its designated hex and ends up in a random adjacent hex instead. This fly-in counts as a movement for Full Throttle.
StormboyzStrike.name: Stormboyz Strike

Stormcaller.description:
Target an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. The target's hex and all adjacent hexes get covered in <style=Effect_Ice>Ice</style>. All enemies on hexes covered in <style=Effect_Ice>Ice</style> take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style>. Flying enemies damaged this way get <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style> for 1 round.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
Stormcaller.name: Stormcaller

StormOfFlensingBlades.description: Attacks an adjacent enemy twice in a row, as long as the <style=Faction_Necrons>Flayed One</style> started the turn adjacent to it.
StormOfFlensingBlades.name: Storm of Flensing Blades

StormOfWrath.description:
Deals <style=Stat_Hits>1x</style> <style=DMG_Psychic>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a unit within 2 hexes and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} adjacent units.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
StormOfWrath.name: Storm Of Wrath

StranglethornCannon.description: The Hive Tyrant attacks using its Stranglethorn Cannon, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to an initial target within {[range]} hexes. Any units adjacent to the target suffer <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage</style>.
StranglethornCannon.name: Stranglethorn Cannon

StructuralAnalyser.description:
Units hit by ranged attacks from <style=Faction_Tau>Darkstrider</style> receive a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style> for one round.

Friendly units adjacent to Darkstrider deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks against targets with a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style>. Friendly <style=Faction_Tau>T'au Empire</style> units within 2 hexes of Darkstrider are also affected.
StructuralAnalyser.name: Structural Analyser

SummaryExecution.description: Friendly units with <style=Battle_Fatigue>Battle Fatigue</style> gain <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. The first time a friendly unit would flee due to <style=Battle_Fatigue>Battle Fatigue</style>, it is executed instead and all other friendly units with the trait ignore it and gain an additional <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style>.
SummaryExecution.name: Summary Execution

SupaCyborkBody.description: The relic bearer can be <style=Healing>healed</style> as well as <style=Repairing>repaired</style> and additionally takes <style=Stat_CritDamage>-{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage</style> for each adjacent enemy unit.
SupaCyborkBody.name: Supa-Cybork Body

Supercharge.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Plasma>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style> to a target enemy within range {[range]} and <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Plasma>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Plasma Damage</style> to up to two enemies in adjacent hexes behind the target, all with <style=Piercing_Ratio>+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style>. Until the beginning of <style=Faction_DarkAngels>Sarquael</style>'s next turn, any further <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> that deal <style=DMG_Plasma>Plasma Damage</style> against these units also have <style=Piercing_Ratio>+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style>.
Supercharge.name: Supercharge

SupremeCommander.description:
Summons up to <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style><style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsman</style></style> in free adjacent hexes. All friendly <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsmen</style></style> within {[range]} hexes then immediately take a turn. If <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Colour Sergeant Kell</style> is in play, summons an additional <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Cadian Guardsman</style></style> and activation range is 3.

Cadian Guardsman’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SupremeCommander.name: Supreme Commander

SwornProtector.description:
When Lord Castellan Creed is first targeted in battle, <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Colour Sergeant Kell</style></style> appears in a free adjacent hex. Any time Creed is attacked, <style=Summon><style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Kell</style></style> switches hexes with him and takes the <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> instead, if they are adjacent to each other. 

Kell’s stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SwornProtector.name: Sworn Protector

SynapticBacklash.description: Whenever the Tervigon sustains a <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crit</style>, friendly Termagants within {[range]} hexes are also dealt {[dmgPct]}% of that attack’s <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style>.
SynapticBacklash.name: Synaptic Backlash

SynapticImperative.description: All friendly units adjacent to this unit have a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}% chance</style> to be revived at <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> when suffering lethal <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style>, unless <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>. This can only happen once per unit per turn.
SynapticImperative.name: Synaptic Imperative

SynapticInsight.description: This unit's ranged attacks score <style=Stat_Hits>+{[extraHit]} hits</style> against targets that are within <style=Synapse>Synapse</style> range or adjacent to another <style=Faction_Tyranids>Tyranid</style>.
SynapticInsight.name: Synaptic Insight

SynapticLinchpin.description:
Whenever the <style=Faction_Tyranids>Winged Prime</style>, or another friendly unit with <style=Synapse>Synapse</style>, performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style> against an enemy and that enemy is not defeated, summons a <style=Summon><style=Faction_Tyranids>Hormagaunt</style></style> adjacent to the target, which immediately attacks the enemy. Cannot have more than <style=Stat>{[maxSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_Tyranids>Hormagaunts</style></style> summoned this way at the same time.

Hormagaunt stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
SynapticLinchpin.name: Synaptic Linchpin

TacticalPrecision.description: Attacks a targeted adjacent enemy. If Titus has charged that enemy this turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to it. This attack is always a Crit and deals an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. If Titus did not charge the targeted enemy this turn, he instead deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Chain Damage to all adjacent enemies. When Titus gets revived or resurrected and Tactical Precision has already been used, then Tactical Precision can be used again in this battle.
TacticalPrecision.name: Tactical Precision

TaintedNarthecium.description: An adjacent friendly <style=Aliance_Chaos>Chaos</style> unit that is defeated has a <style=Stat_Chance>{[chance]}% chance</style> to be revived with <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style>, even if <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>. Can only be triggered once per turn.
TaintedNarthecium.name: Tainted Narthecium

TalismanOfRage.description: Each time the relic bearer defeats an enemy with a melee attack, it counts twice for <style=BlessingsOfKhorne>Blessings Of Khorne</style>. The relic bearer takes <style=Stat_CritDamage>-{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage</style> for each level of <style=BlessingsOfKhorne>Blessings Of Khorne</style>.
TalismanOfRage.name: Talisman of Rage

TalonOfHorus.description: When <style=Faction_BlackLegion>Abaddon</style> performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attack</style>, he also deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Abaddon.
TalonOfHorus.name: Talon of Horus

TalonsOfTheEmperor.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy unit. This attack deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each time a friendly <style=Character>Character</style> has used an active ability this battle. If the target is a <style=Psyker>Psyker</style> or <style=Faction_Custodes>Atlacoya</style> is adjacent to a friendly <style=Faction_Custodes>Adeptus Custodes</style>, this attack deals <style=DMG_Direct>Direct Damage</style> instead.
TalonsOfTheEmperor.name: Talons Of The Emperor

TargetingProtocols.description: Sets up to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of the <style=Faction_Necrons>Menhir</style>'s next turn any unit in those hexes is hit by an Annihilator Beam and is dealt <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style>.
TargetingProtocols.name: Targeting Protocols

TargetLock.description: At the beginning of the <style=Faction_Tau>Riptide</style>'s turn, it deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemy units with a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style>.
TargetLock.name: Target Lock

TerrifyingCrescendo.description: <style=Faction_EmperorsChildren>Shiron</style>'s ranged attacks deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each time he <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style> or would have <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style> an enemy unit, up to a maximum of {[buffMaxLevel]} times.
TerrifyingCrescendo.name: Terrifying Crescendo

TerrorsLament.description: Adjacent enemy units deal <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> and have <style=Stat_Hits>-{[hitsReduction]}</style> hits with melee attacks, to a minimum of 1.
TerrorsLament.name: Terror's Lament

TheArdentBlade.description: The first time each turn that <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Celestine</style> defeats an enemy unit, she resurrects one of her <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Geminae Superia</style> with <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> in a free adjacent hex. If they cannot be resurrected, then one of them within {[range]} hexes takes an action instead.
TheArdentBlade.name: The Ardent Blade

TheBetrayer.description:
After performing a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style>, <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Kh\xe2rn</style> performs a second attack against an adjacent enemy, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Eviscerate>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage</style>.

If <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Kh\xe2rn</style> has defeated an enemy this battle, at the start of his turn, he automatically moves up to {[range]} hexes towards the nearest unit and then deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Eviscerate>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage</style> to an adjacent unit. <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Kh\xe2rn</style> prefers enemies for this automatic move and attack, but targets friendly units if no enemy is in range.
TheBetrayer.name: The Betrayer

TheBloodyHanded.description: Other friendly <style=Faction_Aeldari>Aeldari</style> units are <style=Unstoppable>Unstoppable</style> and deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against enemies standing on <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style>.
TheBloodyHanded.name: The Bloody Handed

TheLantern.description:
Conjures a miasma of pestilence in one of six directions that fills a 3x3 hex area adjacent to <style=Faction_DeathGuard>Mortarion</style>. Enemy units hit by the miasma are <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style>. At the beginning of <style=Faction_DeathGuard>Mortarion</style>'s next turn he fires The Lantern's beam in an arc over the affected area, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Energy>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage</style> to each enemy unit in the area.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
TheLantern.name: The Lantern

TheQuickening.description: Targets a hex within movement range {[range]} that is neither occupied by an enemy nor by a friendly unit in <style=Teleport_Strike_short>Deep Strike</style>. <style=Faction_BloodAngels>Mephiston</style> moves onto that hex. If a friendly unit is on that hex, that unit moves to Mephiston's previous location. All <style=Faction_BloodAngels>Blood Angels</style> moving this way perform a <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attack</style> after they move, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of their own damage to a maximum of <style=Stat_Damage>{[maxDmg]} Damage</style>. Units moving this way do not trigger <style=Buff_Overwatching>Overwatch</style> or other movement related reactions.
TheQuickening.name: The Quickening

TheWailingDoomStrikes.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide and originating from the Avatar of Khaine on <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style>, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Melta>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.
TheWailingDoomStrikes.name: The Wailing Doom Strikes

TheWailingDoomSweeps.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets a cone of hexes in range 2 in front of it on <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style>, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style=DMG_Melta>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.
TheWailingDoomSweeps.name: The Wailing Doom Sweeps

TheWildHost.description:
Reduces all incoming damage by <style=Stat_Damage>{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style>. <style=Faction_Aeldari>Aethana</style> loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> each time she is attacked. At the beginning of <style=Faction_Aeldari>Aethana</style>'s turn, units on marked hexes take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Projectile>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style>, and she marks all hexes of units that attacked her last turn.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
TheWildHost.name: The Wild Host

TheWrathfulDead.description: On each of his turns, {[nrOfSummons]} <style=Summon><style=Faction_DeathGuard>Poxwalkers</style></style> spawn on the map in random free hexes, preferring hexes that are not adjacent to enemy <style=Character>Characters</style>. The spawned <style=Summon><style=Faction_DeathGuard>Poxwalkers</style></style> don't move on the turn they are summoned, but will attack a target in range if there is one. Any time a friendly unit is defeated, <style=Faction_DeathGuard>Corrodius</style> also takes <style=DMG_Direct>Direct Damage</style> equal to {[healthPct]}% of the defeated unit's maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>.
TheWrathfulDead.name: The Wrathful Dead

TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashed.description: At the beginning of the <style=Faction_Aeldari>Avatar of Khaine</style>'s next turn, deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies within {[range]} hexes that are not standing on healing hexes, extinguishes all <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style> in the affected area, and <style=Displacement>pushes</style> all adjacent enemies one hex.
TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashed.name: The Wrath of Khaine Unleashed

ThriceBlessedConflagration.description:
Targets a friendly unit on the battlefield. For <style=Stat>{[nrOfRounds]}</style> rounds, it deals <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with ranged attacks against enemies on <style=Effect_Fire>Fire</style> hexes. Affected <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Adepta Sororitas</style> units deal additional damage with all attacks instead. The <style=Faction_Sisterhood>Exorcist</style> then deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all enemies in the longest uninterrupted straight line originating from the targeted friendly unit.

Initial <style=Cooldown>cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>. 
Cost: <style=Resource_MachinesOfWarAmmo>{[munitionsCost]} munition</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
ThriceBlessedConflagration.name: Thrice-Blessed Conflagration

ThunderousAssault.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Power>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and <style=Displacement>pushes</style> it one hex backwards. The target is <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style> for 1 round. <style=Faction_BlackTemplars>Sword Brother Godswyl</style> then moves into the vacated hex if able. Enemies defeated by this attack are <style=Obliterated>always overkilled</style>.
ThunderousAssault.name: Thunderous Assault

TimeFlux.description:
At the beginning of his turn, <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Toth</style> <style=Regenerate>regenerates</style> <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> plus an additional amount equal to the <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> of the last <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> he received in the last enemy turn. The total amount restored cannot exceed <style=Stat_Health>{[maxHpToHeal]} Health</style>.

When <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Toth</style> moves, he leaves a time ghost behind on the hex he moved from. The time ghost vanishes if the hex becomes occupied by another unit or if the terrain becomes impassable (as with <style=Tile_Floe>Broken Ice</style>). The first time <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Toth</style> dies each battle, if his time ghost is on the battlefield then he revives with <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> remaining at its location. This works even if <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Toth</style> is <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>.
TimeFlux.name: Time Flux

ToughToKill.description: At the beginning of his turn, <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Dreir</style> <style=Regenerate>regenerates</style> <style=Stat_Health>{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>. All attacks against Dreir have <style=Stat>-{[critChanceReduction]}% Crit Chance</style> and deal <style=Stat_CritDamage>-{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage</style>.
ToughToKill.name: Tough to Kill

TreasonOfTzeentch.description: Teleports an enemy character to another random hex and creates a copy of the character in its old location. The copy fights on the side of <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Magnus</style> and has <style=Stat>{[hpPct]}%</style> of the original character's maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>. All other stats and ability levels are identical.
TreasonOfTzeentch.name: Treason of Tzeentch

TrophyTaker.description: <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Tarvakh</style>'s attacks against units that are at or below {[hpPct]}% of their maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> deal<style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and an additional <style=Stat_CritDamage>+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style>. His <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crit chance</style> is increased by <style=Stat>{[extraCritChance]}%</style> for each unit that he defeated this battle.
TrophyTaker.name: Trophy Taker

TunnelingHorror.description: This unit may use tunnelling to move. It is then removed from the battlefield and emerges in its chosen hex at the start of its next turn, <style=Displacement>pushing</style> any unit in that hex aside. It is then able to immediately attack any adjacent enemy in <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style>.
TunnelingHorror.name: Tunnelling Horror

TwinSmartMissileSystem.description:
Targets an enemy unit on the battlefield, then deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to each enemy unit that has a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style>. The target unit then receives a Markerlight for 2 rounds.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
TwinSmartMissileSystem.name: Twin Smart Missile System

TwistedScience.description: Units healed by Hollan, other than himself, are affected by Twisted Science until they are defeated. Hollan can heal other unaffected units even if they are at full Health. Affected units immediately gain {[hp]} Health and their maximum Health increases by the same amount. If they are a Genestealer Cults unit, they also deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage while affected. Affected units cannot gain the effects of Twisted Science again.
TwistedScience.name: Twisted Science

TzeentchsFirestorm.description:
Marks all hexes exactly {[range_2]} hexes away from <style=Faction_ThousandSons>Magnus</style> in a ring around him. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemy units on marked hexes receive <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x </style> <style=DMG_Flame>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style>. For the next 2 turns, the process repeats, reducing the ring radius by {[range]} and increasing hits to enemies in marked hexes by <style=Stat_Hits>{[extraHits]}</style> each turn. Magnus can move independently of the ring after the initial turn of casting.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
TzeentchsFirestorm.name: Tzeentch's Firestorm

UnbreakableDuty.description: <style=Faction_BlackTemplars>Ancient Thoread</style> and all friendly units within {[range]} hexes receive <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> until the start of their next turn. If 2 or more friendly <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> <style=Character>Characters</style> are dead upon activation of this ability, <style=Faction_BlackTemplars>Ancient Thoread</style> gains <style=Stat_Health>{[extraHp]} extra Health</style> and <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> until the end of the battle and immediately performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style> against an adjacent enemy.
UnbreakableDuty.name: Unbreakable Duty

UnbridledCarnageReworked.description: At the end of <style=Faction_Orks>Tanksmasha's</style> turn, <style=Summon><style=Faction_Orks>Grots</style></style> and <style=Object>Explosive Oil Drums</style> rain from the sky. If an Explosive Oil Drum gets destroyed, it explodes, damaging units on adjacent hexes. Tanksmasha loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> from the explosion and all other characters take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]} hit</style> that inflicts <style=DMG_Blast>Blast Damage</style> equal to {[dmgPct]}% of the character's maximum <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>. All affected <style=Summon>Summons</style> are destroyed.
UnbridledCarnageReworked.name: Clusta Bomma Precishun Strike

UnparalleledFerocity.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Physical>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies, with a <style=Stat>100% Crit Chance</style> against<style=Summon>Summons</style>.
UnparalleledFerocity.name: Unparalleled Ferocity

UnstoppableFerocity.description:
Scores one additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> when attacking an enemy <style=Psyker>Psyker</style>. 
Scores one additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> when <style=Charging>charging</style>.
UnstoppableFerocity.name: Unstoppable Ferocity

UnstoppableMomentumReworked.description:
Charges in one of 6 directions and keeps moving in a straight line until he hits an obstacle or a <style=Big_Target>Big Target</style>. Any enemies hit by the charge take <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Direct>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>, increased by <style=Stat_Damage>{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each hex traversed from the starting hex to the enemy. Affected enemies get <style=Displacement>pushed</style> and <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style> for 1 round. A <style=Big_Target>Big Target</style> is <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style> for 1 round instead. Friendly units are also displaced, but take no damage or negative effects.

Initial <style=Cooldown>cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.
UnstoppableMomentumReworked.name: Unstoppable Momentum

UnwaveringSentinel.description: During each enemy turn, after <style=Faction_Custodes>Tyrith</style> is attacked and the attacker is within range {[range]}, she deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Bolter>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to the attacker. If there is an enemy adjacent to Tyrith, the range of this ability is reduced to 1.
UnwaveringSentinel.name: Unwavering Sentinel

ValkyrieStrike.description:
Calls in an air strike on a target hex anywhere on the battlefield, which gets marked with red smoke. After one round, the target hex and two random surrounding hexes are hit with Hellstrike Missiles, each dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Blast>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style>.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
ValkyrieStrike.name: Valkyrie Strike

VengeanceForTheOmnissiah.description: Whenever an adjacent friendly <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> is defeated, the <style=Faction_AdeptusMechanicus>Tech-Priest Enginseer</style> gains <style=Stat>{[effectLevel]}</style> level of <style=Buff_MachineVengeance>Machine Vengeance</style>.
VengeanceForTheOmnissiah.name: Vengeance for the Omnissiah

VexillaMagnifica.description: Deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Physical>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy target and an additional adjacent enemy unit. Both enemies are <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style> for 1 round, and <style=Faction_Custodes>Aesoth</style> receives <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style=Cooldown>cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds.</style>
VexillaMagnifica.name: Vexilla Magnifica

VigilanceEternal.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} of Tyrith or is already on a hex adjacent to Tyrith. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the targeted unit. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. Using Vigilance Eternal does not end Tyrith's turn.
VigilanceEternal.name: Vigilance Eternal

VisionsOfHeresy.description: After performing a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style>, <style=Faction_BloodAngels>Lucien</style> performs a second attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Bolter>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style>. If Lucien is at or below <style=Stat_Health>{[healthPct]}% Health</style>, all of his attacks have <style=Piercing_Ratio>+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style>.
VisionsOfHeresy.name: Visions of Heresy

Vitarus.description: The hexes of each enemy hit by Mephiston's normal melee attack or by Fury of the Ancients are set on Fire. If these attacks hit enemies on hexes with Fire, they deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and extinguish the Fire.
Vitarus.name: Vitarus

Volatile.description:
If this unit is <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style> it deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Bolter>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to all adjacent tiles.

<i>This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot <style=" Stat_CritDamage
Volatile.name: Volatile

VoltagheistField.description: If <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> is restored to this unit, the amount restored is reduced by <style=Stat>{[healthPct]}%</style> and it then scores <style=Stat_Hits>+{[extraHit]} hit</style> with <style=NormalAttack>normal attacks</style> until the end of its turn.
VoltagheistField.name: Voltagheist Field

VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.description: Each time this unit is dealt <style=DMG_Flame>Flame Damage</style> or <style=DMG_Blast>Blast Damage</style>, it loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done. This unit takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from hits that do not deal <style=DMG_Flame>Flame Damage</style> or <style=DMG_Blast>Blast Damage</style>.
VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.name: Vulnerable to Flame and Blast

VulnerableToMelee.description: Each time this unit is dealt Damage by a <style=Stat_Melee>Melee attack</style>, it loses <style=Stat_Health>{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done. This unit takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> from attacks that are not <style=Stat_Melee>Melee attacks</style>.
VulnerableToMelee.name: Vulnerable to Melee

Waaagh.description:
If <style=Faction_Orks>Boss Gulgortz</style> has not moved, he summons <style=Stat>{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style=Summon><style=Faction_Orks>Ork Boyz</style></style> in free adjacent hexes. Until the end of this turn, all friendly <style=Faction_Orks>Orks</style> and friendly units adjacent to <style=Faction_Orks>Boss Gulgortz</style> gain <style=Stat_Movement>+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> and their <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attacks</style> deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and score an additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>. <style=Faction_Orks>Boss Gulgortz</style> then <style=Charging>charges</style> a targeted enemy in movement range, performing a <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attack</style> against it. All friendly <style=Faction_Orks>Ork Boyz</style> take a turn.

Ork Boyz' stats:
<style=Stat_Health>{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style=Stat_Damage>{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style=Stat_Armor>{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>
Waaagh.name: Waaagh!

WallOfMirrors.description: If the <style=Faction_Tau>Stealth Battlesuit</style> has not moved, it disappears from its current hex and reappears on a free hex on the battlefield from which it can perform a <style=NormalAttack>normal ranged attack</style> against an enemy that has a <style=Debuff_Markerlight>Markerlight</style>. This attack has <style=Piercing_Ratio>+{[extraPierce]}% Pierce Ratio</style>.
WallOfMirrors.name: Wall of Mirrors

WarConstruct.description: For 1 round, if there is no enemy adjacent to the <style=Faction_Aeldari>Wraithguard</style>, it shoots back at each enemy within range that attacks it or a friendly adjacent <style=Faction_Aeldari>Aeldari</style>.
WarConstruct.name: War Construct

WarHowl.description: If Ragnar has not moved, he and all friendly Characters that don't have a normal ranged attack gain Unstoppable until the end of this turn. Additionally, their normal melee attacks have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of this turn. Using War Howl does not end Ragnar's turn.
WarHowl.name: War Howl

WayOfTheShortBlade.description:
Normal ranged attacks of other friendly Characters within 2 hexes against enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Character ignore <style=Piercing_Ratio>{[armorIgnored]}</style> Armour and deal <style=Stat_Damage>+{[extraDmgPct]}%</style> Damage, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage.

Commander Farsight and other friendly T'au Empire Characters within 2 hexes that perform a melee attack immediately perform a normal ranged attack against the same unit, even if they are adjacent to it.
WayOfTheShortBlade.name: Way of the Short Blade

WeakerRearArmour.description: If enemies are inside the rear arc of the <style=Faction_AstraMilitarum>Rogal Dorn Battle Tank</style>, their attacks have <style=Stat>+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> against it.
WeakerRearArmour.name: Weaker Rear Armour

WhipcoilBody.description: This unit takes <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from melee attacks.
WhipcoilBody.name: Whipcoil Body

WireweaveNet.description: The first time <style=Faction_Aeldari>Calandis</style> is targeted by a <style=NormalAttack>normal melee attack</style> during the enemy's turn, the attacker immediately takes <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Piercing>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style>. If the attacker is eliminated, their melee attack is not executed.
WireweaveNet.name: Wireweave Net

WisdomOfTheAncients.description: Friendly <style=Rarity_Mythic>Mythic</style> <style=Character>characters</style> take <style=Stat_Damage>-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> if they are adjacent to <style=Faction_Ultramarines>Galatian</style> or a friendly Mythic character.
WisdomOfTheAncients.name: Wisdom of the Ancients

Wraithcannon.description: When performing a ranged attack, deals <style=Stat_Hits>{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style=DMG_Direct>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to an enemy behind the target.
Wraithcannon.name: Wraithcannon

WrathfulDevotion.description: When <style=Faction_WorldEaters>Wrask</style> arrives from <style=Teleport_Strike_short>Deep Strike</style> or defeats an enemy in <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style>, he and adjacent friendly <style=Aliance_Chaos>Chaos</style> units gain a <style=Buff_Shield>Shield</style> with <style=Stat_Health>{[shieldHp]} Health</style> for 1 round.
WrathfulDevotion.name: Wrathful Devotion
